title: prs output
description: Printed on exit 0, and on exit 12 (partial_results) with errors listing the hosts that failed.

complete.description: false if older items were cut, including by GitHub's 1000-result search limit, if an item was dropped (hidden, a duplicate, or no longer matching the state or draft filter), or if any host asked failed.

query.description: Present with --query or --default-query: the canonical text of the query that was applied (empty for the empty query).

snapshot_failures.description: Present only when a query read snapshots and some could not be read: each listed PR whose snapshot failed. The filter cannot decide such a row (its snapshot fields are unknown), so it is in items only when the filter is true whatever those fields are (in_items). complete is false then.

message.description: Untrusted: redacted of tokens, one line.
